description: Using Oracle SQL Developer (a System Admin connection is pre-configured), create a new database user called REPORT_USER with password 'Report2024'. This user needs read-only access to HR data for reporting purposes. Grant SELECT privileges on the HR schema's EMPLOYEES, DEPARTMENTS, and JOBS tables. Configure the user with default tablespace USERS and a quota of 10M. Verify the setup works by connecting as REPORT_USER and querying HR.EMPLOYEES.
